ev.breakEven: Win rate needed to break even
ev.streakProb: Chance of a streak of at least {k} losses in {n} trades
ev.ruinProb: Chance capital hits the ruin line within {n} trades
ev.belowStart: Chance of ending below the start
ev.positive: With these numbers the strategy has a positive expected value. That's necessary, not sufficient: check that the numbers aren't luck or curve fitting.
ev.negative: With these numbers every trade loses on average. Breaking even needs a win rate of {breakEven}; this has {p}. A high win rate means nothing when the losses are much bigger than the wins.
ev.chart: Distribution of capital after {n} trades (exact, not simulated)
ev.chartSummary: Average {mean}; chance of ending below the start {below}.

luck.p0: Win rate with no edge at all
luck.p0Hint: usually 50%, or the break-even rate from the EV checker
luck.tries: How many strategies or people tried
luck.triesHint: you only see the one that worked
luck.tail: Chance of at least {k} wins out of {n} by pure luck
luck.anyTail: Chance that at least one of {m} tries looks like this by luck
luck.chart: Distribution of wins out of {n} with no edge
luck.chartSummary: Chance of a result as good as claimed or better: {tail}.
luck.sharpeP: Chance of such a Sharpe with no edge
luck.anySharpe: Chance at least one of {m} tries reaches it
luck.bestSharpe: The best Sharpe to expect from {m} tries with no edge
luck.lucky: Luck explains this result easily, especially when many people or strategies tried and only the best one is shown.
luck.notLucky: Luck alone hardly explains this result. That's not yet proof of an edge: check costs, the period, and whether the result was fitted to the past.

mlm.saturation: Level at which people run out
mlm.bottom: Members at the bottom who recruited nobody
mlm.breakEven: Direct recruits needed to earn the price back (all levels)
mlm.breakEvenDirect: The same, counting direct recruits only
mlm.logNote: Each level is as many times bigger than the one above as the number of people each member must bring. The last full level always holds most members, with nobody left to recruit.

indicators.chartLabel: Random walk with signals: {buys} buys, {sells} sells
indicators.legend: The price is pure chance (a random walk). ▲ buy, ▼ sell.
indicators.conclusion: Signals appear even where, by definition, there is nothing to predict, and their hit rate hovers around a coin flip. An indicator "showing" something is not evidence of an edge.
